info.title: Upload File Init
info.description:
To upload a large file to TikTok Shop, such as a video, first use this API to initialize the upload session. Then upload the file to the returned upload URL; files smaller than 5 MB must be uploaded as a single, non-chunked request. After the upload step returns a ResourceId, pass that ResourceId to the API for the target path.
For more details, see https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/wfi3nz36.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description:
Depends on the auth type of the API. 
1. The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.
2. The creator access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 1. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a362dccb8030ea6f98c) to get creator access_token.
3. The partner access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 3. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3978f4c20311b8b555) to get partner access_token.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

parameters.name: category_asset_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return The partner identifier used in API requests. 
Retrieve this value by using the [Get Authorized Category Assets API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/666012dd609d4402cc3be995).

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

file_name.description: The name of the file to upload for this upload session.

file_type.description: The type of file to upload. Currently, only video is supported.

target_path.description: After the video is uploaded, use this interface to bind the video resource to the specific material

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

upload_url.description: The URL provided by platform where the file can be uploaded.

upload_token.description: The upload token used when uploading the file to the returned upload URL.
